readings.title: The Singular Rock of Refuge
readings.subtitle: Leaning the Full Weight on the Deliverer
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:1] Then Daviḏ spoke to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>את</dn> the words of this song, on the day when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had delivered <dn>את</dn> him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Sha’ul. [2] And he said, “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is my rock and my stronghold and my deliverer. [3] “My <dn>Elohim</dn> is my rock, I take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>, My shield and the horn of my deliverance, My high tower and my refuge. My Saviour, <dn>You</dn> save me from violence. [4] “I call on <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the One to be praised, And I am saved from my enemies.

readings.title: The Floods of Beliya’al
readings.subtitle: A Cry from the Crucible
readings.text: [5] “For the waves of death surrounded me, Floods of Beliya’al made me afraid, [6] “The cords of She’ol were all around me; The snares of death were before me. [7] “In my distress I called upon <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And to my <dn>Elohim</dn> I cried. And from <dn>His</dn> Hĕḵal <dn>He</dn> heard my voice, And my cry was in <dn>His</dn> ears.”

readings.title: The Physics of Divine Wrath
readings.subtitle: Atmospheric Rebuke and Judgment
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:8] “And the earth shook and trembled, The foundations of the heavens were troubled, Because <dn>He</dn> was wroth. [9] “Smoke went up from <dn>His</dn> nostrils, And devouring fire from <dn>His</dn> mouth; Coals were kindled by it. [10] “And <dn>He</dn> bowed the heavens and came down, And thick darkness was under <dn>His</dn> feet. [11] “And <dn>He</dn> rode upon a keruḇ, and flew, And was seen upon the wings of the wind. [12] “And <dn>He</dn> put darkness around <dn>Him</dn> as booths, Darkness of waters, thick clouds. [13] “From the brightness before <dn>Him</dn> Coals of fire were kindled. [14] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> thundered from the heavens, And the Most High sent forth <dn>His</dn> voice. [15] “And <dn>He</dn> sent out arrows and scattered them, Lightning, and confused them. [16] “And the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered At the rebuke of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, At the blast of the breath of <dn>His</dn> nostrils.

readings.title: Drawn from Many Waters
readings.subtitle: The Providence of the Hidden Face
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:17] “<dn>He</dn> sent from above, <dn>He</dn> took me, <dn>He</dn> drew me out of many waters. [18] “<dn>He</dn> delivered me from my strong enemy, From those hating me, For they were stronger than I. [19] “They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was my support. [20] “And <dn>He</dn> brought me out into a large place, <dn>He</dn> delivered me for <dn>He</dn> delighted in me.

readings.title: The Architecture of Premial Justice
readings.subtitle: Repayment for a Perfected State
readings.text: [21] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands <dn>He</dn> repaid me. [22] “For I have guarded the ways of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And have not acted wrongly against my <dn>Elohim</dn>. [23] “For all <dn>His</dn> right-rulings are before me; As for <dn>His</dn> laws, I do not turn from them. [24] “And I am perfect before <dn>Him</dn>, And I guard myself from my crookedness. [25] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> repays me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness before <dn>His</dn> eyes.

readings.title: The Reflection of Character States
readings.subtitle: Light Piercing the Systemic Darkness
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:26] “With the lovingly-commited ones <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> lovingly-commited, With the perfect one <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> perfect, [27] “With the clean <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> clean, And with the crooked <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> twisted. [28] “For <dn>You</dn> save <dn>את</dn> the humble people, But <dn>Your</dn> eyes are on the haughty to bring them low. [29] “For <dn>You</dn> are my lamp, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> makes my darkness light. [30] “For with <dn>You</dn> I run against a band, With my <dn>Elohim</dn> I leap over a wall.

readings.title: The Proven Word
readings.subtitle: The Shield of Absolute Trust
readings.text: [31] “The <dn>Ěl</dn> – <dn>His</dn> way is perfect; The Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is proven; <dn>He</dn> is a shield to all who take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>. [32] “For who is <dn>Ěl</dn>, besides <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? And who is a rock, besides our <dn>Elohim</dn>? [33] "<dn>Ěl</dn> is my mighty stronghold, And <dn>He</dn> makes my way perfect, [34] “Making my feet like the feet of deer, And sets me on my high places, [35] “Teaching my hands for battle, So that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

readings.title: The Right Arm in Battle
readings.subtitle: Reducing the Adversary to Dust
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:36] “And <dn>You</dn> give me the shield of <dn>Your</dn> deliverance, And <dn>Your</dn> lowliness makes me great. [37] “<dn>You</dn> enlarge my step under me, So that my feet shall not slip. [38] “I pursue my enemies and destroy them, And I do not turn back till they are destroyed. [39] “And I destroy them and crush them, So that they do not rise, And fall under my feet. [40] “And <dn>You</dn> gird me with strength for battle, <dn>You</dn> cause my adversaries to bow under me. [41] “And <dn>You</dn> make my enemies turn their backs, Those hating me, and I cut them off. [42] “They look but there is no saviour, Unto <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, but <dn>He</dn> shall not answer them. [43] “And I beat them as dust of the earth, I beat them small as dirt in the streets – I spread them out.

readings.title: The Appointed Head of the Nations
readings.subtitle: The Eternal Guarantee to the Seed
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:44] “And <dn>You</dn> deliver me from the strivings of my people, <dn>You</dn> safeguard me as the head of the nations; A people I have not known serve me. [45] “Sons of the foreigner submit to me, As soon as they hear they obey me. [46] “Sons of the foreigner fade away, And gird themselves from their strongholds. [47] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> lives! And blessed is my Rock! And exalted is my <dn>Elohim</dn>, The Rock of my deliverance, [48] "<dn>Ěl</dn> who avenges me, And bringing peoples down under me, [49] “And bringing me out from my enemies; <dn>You</dn> raise me up above those rising up against me; <dn>You</dn> deliver me from a man of violence. [50] “Therefore I give thanks to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, among nations, And I sing praise to <dn>Your</dn> Name. [51] “A tower of deliverance is <dn>He</dn> to <dn>His</dn> sovereign, And showing loving-commitment to <dn>His</dn> anointed, To Daviḏ and his seed, forever.”

readings.title: The Singular Rock of Refuge
readings.subtitle: Leaning the Full Weight on the Deliverer
readings.text: [Psalm 18:1] I love <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, My strength. [2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is my rock and my stronghold and my deliverer; My <dn>Ěl</dn> is my rock, I take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>; My shield and the horn of my deliverance, my high tower. [3] I call upon <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the One to be praised, And I am saved from my enemies.

readings.title: The Floods of Beliya’al
readings.subtitle: A Cry from the Crucible
readings.text: [4] The cords of death surrounded me, And the floods of Beliya’al made me afraid. [5] The cords of She’ol were all around me; The snares of death were before me. [6] In my distress I called upon <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And to my <dn>Elohim</dn> I cried; <dn>He</dn> heard my voice from <dn>His</dn> Hĕḵal, And my cry went before <dn>Him</dn>, into <dn>His</dn> ears.

readings.title: The Physics of Divine Wrath
readings.subtitle: Atmospheric Rebuke and Judgment
readings.text: [Psalm 18:7] And the earth shook and trembled; Even the foundations of the mountains were troubled And they shook, because <dn>He</dn> was wroth. [8] Smoke went up from <dn>His</dn> nostrils, And consuming fire from <dn>His</dn> mouth; Coals were kindled by it. [9] And <dn>He</dn> bowed the heavens and came down, And thick darkness was under <dn>His</dn> feet. [10] And <dn>He</dn> rode upon a keruḇ, and flew; <dn>He</dn> flew upon the wings of the wind. [11] <dn>He</dn> made darkness <dn>His</dn> covering; Around <dn>Him</dn> <dn>His</dn> booth, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies. [12] From the brightness before <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>His</dn> thick clouds passed, hail and coals of fire. [13] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> thundered in the heavens, And the Most High sent forth <dn>His</dn> voice, Hail and coals of fire. [14] And <dn>He</dn> sent out <dn>His</dn> arrows and scattered them, And much lightning, and confused them. [15] And the channels of waters were seen, And the foundations of the world were uncovered At <dn>Your</dn> rebuke, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, At the blast of the breath of <dn>Your</dn> nostrils.

readings.title: Drawn from Many Waters
readings.subtitle: The Providence of the Hidden Face
readings.text: [Psalm 18:16] <dn>He</dn> sent from above, <dn>He</dn> took me; <dn>He</dn> drew me out of many waters. [17] <dn>He</dn> delivered me from my strong enemy, And from those hating me, For they were stronger than I. [18] They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was my support. [19] And <dn>He</dn> brought me out into a large place; <dn>He</dn> delivered me for <dn>He</dn> delighted in me.

readings.title: The Architecture of Premial Justice
readings.subtitle: Repayment for a Perfected State
readings.text: [20] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands <dn>He</dn> repaid me. [21] For I have guarded the ways of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And have not acted wrongly against my <dn>Elohim</dn>. [22] For all <dn>His</dn> right-rulings are before me, And I did not turn from <dn>His</dn> laws. [23] And I am perfect before <dn>Him</dn>, And I guard myself from my crookedness. [24] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> repays me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands before <dn>His</dn> eyes.

readings.title: The Reflection of Character States
readings.subtitle: Piercing the Systemic Darkness
readings.text: [Psalm 18:25] With the lovingly-committed <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> lovingly-committed; With the perfect one <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> perfect; [26] With the clean <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> clean; And with the crooked <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> twisted. [27] For <dn>You</dn> save the afflicted people, But bring down those whose eyes are haughty. [28] For <dn>You</dn> <dn>Yourself</dn> light my lamp; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn> makes my darkness light. [29] For with <dn>You</dn> I run against a band, And with my <dn>Elohim</dn> I leap over a wall.

readings.title: The Proven Word
readings.subtitle: The Shield of Absolute Trust
readings.text: [30] The <dn>Ěl</dn> – <dn>His</dn> way is perfect; The Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is proven; <dn>He</dn> is a shield to all who take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>. [31] For who is <dn>Eloah</dn>, besides <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? And who is a rock, except our <dn>Elohim</dn>? [32] It is <dn>Ěl</dn> who girds me with strength, And makes my way perfect, [33] Making my feet like the feet of deer, And sets me on my high places, [34] Teaching my hands for battle, So that my arms shall bend a bow of bronze. [35] And <dn>You</dn> give me the shield of <dn>Your</dn> deliverance; And <dn>Your</dn> right hand supports me, And <dn>Your</dn> lowliness makes me great. [36] <dn>You</dn> enlarge my step under me; And my feet shall not slip.

readings.title: The Right Arm in Battle
readings.subtitle: Reducing the Adversary to Dust
readings.text: [Psalm 18:37] I pursue my enemies and overtake them; And do not turn back till they are destroyed. [38] I crush them, and they are unable to rise; They fall under my feet. [39] And <dn>You</dn> gird me with strength for battle; Cause my adversaries to bow under me. [40] And <dn>You</dn> have made my enemies turn their backs, As for those hating me, I cut them off. [41] They cry – but no one is there to save, To <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – but <dn>He</dn> answers them not. [42] And I beat them as dust before the wind; I empty them out like dirt in the streets.

readings.title: The Appointed Head of the Nations
readings.subtitle: The Eternal Guarantee to the Seed
readings.text: [43] <dn>You</dn> deliver me from the strivings of the people, <dn>You</dn> set me at the head of the nations; A people I have not known serve me. [44] As soon as they hear of me they obey me; The foreigners submit to me. [45] The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their strongholds. [46] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> lives! And blessed is my Rock! And exalted is the <dn>Elohim</dn> of my deliverance, [47] The <dn>Ěl</dn> who avenges me, And <dn>He</dn> humbles the peoples under me; [48] My deliverer from my enemies. <dn>You</dn> lift me up above those who rise against me; <dn>You</dn> deliver me from a man of violence. [49] Therefore I give thanks to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, among nations, And I sing praise to <dn>Your</dn> Name, [50] Making great the deliverance of <dn>His</dn> sovereign, And showing loving-commitment to <dn>His</dn> anointed, To Daviḏ and his seed, forever.
